prospects.thesis: Leidos combines a rare defense-tech profile with a compelling 1.0x P/S valuation and a $18B mid-cap footprint, offering exposure to classified IT, AI-enabled intelligence systems, and health analytics for federal agencies. With DoD FY27 budget priorities tilting toward digital modernization and cyber, Leidos's backlog visibility and margin expansion story provide a defensive growth vehicle amid rising 10Y yields. The +32.9% 1M momentum with bullish options and institutional flow signals smart money accumulation ahead of contract award cycles.

SMCI is the leading AI server OEM leveraging NVIDIA GPU allocations into liquid-cooled rack-scale systems for hyperscaler and enterprise AI buildouts, trading at just 0.7x sales — a striking valuation for the pace of top-line growth. Post-audit overhang clearing and reaffirmed Blackwell ramp positions the company for a re-rating as FY27 revenue guidance materializes. The +48.2% 1M move with bullish options flow suggests institutional re-entry after prior governance concerns faded.

MongoDB's Atlas platform is emerging as the de facto vector database layer for enterprise generative AI workloads, with Atlas Vector Search adoption accelerating and AI-driven consumption tailwinds now showing in ARR growth. At $37B cap and 14.2x P/S, it offers pure-play AI infrastructure exposure distinct from hyperscaler concentration. The +38.2% 1M rally with bullish options and institutional positioning reflects renewed conviction ahead of the September earnings catalyst.

Kratos is the pure-play on unmanned systems, tactical drones (Valkyrie), and hypersonic target vehicles — categories directly aligned with the Pentagon's Replicator initiative and CCA (Collaborative Combat Aircraft) program awards. Unlike primes, KTOS offers small-cap torque with $12B market cap and accelerating production tempo. Bullish options and institutional flows plus +30% 1M momentum signal conviction ahead of FY27 defense appropriations targeting autonomous platforms.

UiPath is repositioning from legacy RPA toward agentic AI automation, with its Autopilot and AI agent orchestration layer gaining traction in enterprise workflow deployments. At 5.0x P/S and $8.3B cap, it offers cheaper AI-application exposure versus infrastructure names, with turnaround optionality if net retention stabilizes. The +34% 1M move with bullish options/institutional signals suggests early-stage recovery, but execution risk warrants a Watch rating pending Q2 print confirmation.
